title: Nurses, Registered
description:
Hours:
1pm-11pm, alternating weekends, every Monday off and every other Tuesday and Thursday off (includes 30-minutes unpaid meal break)
Job duties:
Job duties include, but may not be limited to: maintaining general medical inventory (including controlled substances); conducting medication administration; reviewing the overall health conditions of youth (i.e. preparing, reviewing and evaluating nursing intervention plans); ensuring that interventions are consistent with comprehensive treatment plans; participating in staff trainings; preparing required clinical and administrative reports; maintain infection control standards; and, serve as a member of the facility's medical treatment team. Additional duties to be discussed in detail during the interview.

Qualifications:
Licensed and registered to practice nursing in New York State.

title: Auditors
description:
Location: 11 Corporate Woods, Albany, 3 rd FL
. After training and upon approval of bureau management, telecommuting up to 50% of the pay period may be available.
M-F Shift/Schedule: 37.5 - 40 hours, between the hours of 7:30 – 4:30 (30 min unpaid break)
No Holiday work, Overtime or travel required
Free Parking Provided

Position Description :
This is a full-time position with the NYS Medicaid Program's Bureau of Provider Enrollment (BPE). BPE staff are responsible for enrolling, revalidating, and maintaining Medicaid provider files in the eMedNY system and/or in the Provider Services Portal (PSP). This includes:
  • Ensuring that applications and required documentation submitted in the PSP are complete, current, and valid, and that data entered into the PSP complies with federal and State requirements, policies and procedures.
  • Navigating various federal and State databases, including Medicare's enrollment system (PECOS), the NPI Registry (NPPES), the New York State Education Department's (NYSED's) Office of the Professions Verification Search, and other states' licensing verification websites, to verify information supplied on an application is current and valid.
  • In a clear, concise, and professional manner, contacting providers via the PSP, email, or phone if information is incomplete or requires further clarification.
  • Entering and updating provider information in eMedNY and/or the PSP.
  • Meeting production and quality standards.
  • Filing, maintaining, and uploading documents according to procedures.


Additional Skill Level, Experience or Other Requirements:
  • Previous experience reviewing, verifying, validating detailed/sensitive information using web-based verification sources (Preferred)
  • Data entry experience (Preferred)
  • Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office, internet navigation
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Previous customer service experience
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Ability to be flexible, innovative, work independently, recognize and manage priorities with minimal supervision and as a team member
  • High school graduate or equivalent
Employees are requested to refrain from taking time off during the initial training period, up through the first 90 days to ensure the best learning outcomes.
Salary commensurate with scope of work job experience
Proper footwear required to perform tasks in a safe manner.
Perform other reasonably related duties as required.
New Wave People is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO).

title: Receptionists
description:
Receptionist
Monday through Friday from 9 am to 5 pm
with a half hour unpaid lunch break (excluding state holidays).
No Holiday work, Overtime or travel required
No Parking Provided

The position requires experience typing and utilizing Microsoft Word and Outlook as well as having good communication skills, especially verbal.

Following are some of the major duties:
* Answer all telephone calls for 11 person office and notify and/or transfer calls to the proper individual.
* Greet visitors and provide direction and assistance as necessary.
* Check visitor ID and issue badge, then contact the appropriate individual.
* Maintain front desk procedure book, including staffs' schedules.
* Handle multiple tasks and prioritize them.
* Type documents and case notes as required.
* Communicate important information to the person covering reception during breaks and lunch.
* Log incoming and outgoing documents, etc.
* Date stamp incoming mail and documents, etc.
* Utilize Zoom and TEAMS communication platforms.
* Keep documents out of sight of visitors and maintain our participants' confidentiality.
* Learn our case management system to look-up and input information.
Reports to one supervisor.
All visitors go thru security

Salary commensurate with scope of work job experience
Proper footwear required to perform tasks in a safe manner.
Perform other reasonably related duties as required.
